designation: Fictional multi-source radar demonstration system (not ASTERIX on-wire data)

components.name: radar-psr-01
components.function: synthetic rotating sensor, unassociated plots and accepted detection candidates

components.name: track-core
components.function: sensor plot association, configurable quality gating, track lifecycle

components.name: position-bridge
components.function: site reference comparison across manual/GPS/external position sources

components.name: alert-router
components.function: alert match, queued notification delivery and retry

components.name: ui-gateway
components.function: publish and remove visible operator display tracks

DetectionCandidate.comment: candidate/plot need not produce a track; target_id may be blank for unassociated clutter

FilterConfigApplied.comment: threshold applies only to modeled PSR small-return quality filtering

TrackUpdate.comment: track is confirmed after 2 consecutive accepted sensor reports

PositionReport.comment: site/platform reference, not target aircraft position

IFFReply.comment: 4-digit octal code, simulated Mode 3/A reply; no actual raw IFF waveform

constraints.scan_to_candidate: Candidates generally emitted shortly after their radar scan; false plots are routine.
constraints.candidate_to_track: A low-quality candidate can be gated and generate no TrackUpdate; 2 accepted hits required to confirm a new track.
constraints.track_to_display: Confirmed tracks produce UiTrackPublished events; track termination removes display tracks.
constraints.missing_message_rule: Absence may be interpreted only if the selected type and relevant source/time interval were captured completely.
constraints.coordinate_systems: Track x/y are synthetic km relative to fictional site. PositionReport lat/lon in WGS84. Cannot directly compare without a transform.
constraints.clock_semantics: Use capture_time_utc for sniffer chronology; producer_time_utc may be offset by source clock error.
constraints.safety: All names, locations, thresholds and schemas are invented demo conventions; never use as real equipment specifications.
